<blockquote>''- Collect Battlepass points by killing enemies in any game mode!''<br />''- Purchase a Premium Pass for Exclusive rewards!''<br />''★ All previous rewards are automatically claimed on purchase!''</blockquote>The Battlepass has 50 tiers with the later half opening up after a week of release; a free and premium version. Each tier starts at 50 Battlepass points, going up to 1500 Battlepass points per tier which are obtained by killing enemies that can drop between 4 and 15 Battlepass points in any game mode.

Each tier can offers the player '''{{Gems}}, {{Gold}}, [[File:Reroll Token.png|35px|link=Traits|Reroll Tokens]][[Traits|Reroll Tokens]], [[File:Cursed Finger.png|35px|link=Traits|Cursed Fingers]][[Curses|Cursed Fingers]], [[Items|Star Capsules]], Emotes, and exclusive units''', with the premium version providing extra items and shiny units'''.'''  

The premium pass can be purchased for '''R$799'''. Skip 10 levels can be purchased for '''R$999'''. Both are giftable and tradable.
